audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra offering instruction text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for reparation for fraud/theft, restitution plus fifth, priestly instructions for burnt offering, grain offering, priestly grain offering, and purification offering.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.restored: When a soul/life sins/misaligns and acts unfaithfully against YHWH, deceiving his companion concerning deposit, pledge, robbery, or by oppressing his companion,

familiar.text: If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against the LORD, and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived his neighbour;

verses.restored: or has found lost thing and lies concerning it, and swears falsely concerning one from all that a human does to sin/misalign in them,

familiar.text: Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:

verses.restored: then it shall be, because he sinned/misaligned and became guilty, he shall return the robbed thing he robbed, or oppression he oppressed, or deposit deposited with him, or lost thing he found,

familiar.text: Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,

verses.restored: or anything concerning which he swore falsely; he shall repay it by its head and add its fifth to it; to the one to whom it belongs he shall give it on day of his guilt/reparation.

familiar.text: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.

verses.restored: His guilt/reparation offering he shall bring to YHWH: a complete ram from flock, by your valuation, for guilt/reparation offering to priest.

familiar.text: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:

verses.restored: The priest shall make atonement/covering for him before YHWH, and it shall be forgiven him for any of all he did to become guilty by it.

familiar.text: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD: and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing therein.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.restored: Command Aaron and his sons, saying: This is instruction/Torah of burnt offering. Burnt offering itself shall remain on hearth upon altar all night until morning, and fire of altar shall be kept burning on it.

familiar.text: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.

verses.restored: The priest shall put on his linen garment, with linen undergarments on his flesh; he shall lift ashes to which fire consumed burnt offering on altar and put them beside altar.

familiar.text: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

verses.restored: He shall strip off his garments and put on other garments, and bring ashes outside camp to clean place.

familiar.text: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.

verses.restored: Fire on altar shall be kept burning on it; it shall not go out. Priest shall burn wood on it morning by morning, arrange burnt offering on it, and turn fat of peace/well-being offerings into smoke on it.

familiar.text: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.

verses.restored: Fire continually shall be kept burning on altar; it shall not go out.

familiar.text: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.

verses.restored: This is instruction/Torah of grain offering: sons of Aaron shall bring it near before YHWH, before altar.

familiar.text: And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar.

verses.restored: One shall lift from it handful of fine flour of grain offering and from its oil and all frankincense on grain offering, and turn into smoke on altar as soothing scent, its memorial portion to YHWH.

familiar.text: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour, even the memorial of it, unto the LORD.

verses.restored: What remains from it Aaron and his sons shall eat; unleavened it shall be eaten in holy place; in court of tent of meeting they shall eat it.

familiar.text: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.

verses.restored: It shall not be baked leavened. I have given it as their portion from my fire-offerings. Holy of Holies it is, like sin/misalignment offering and guilt/reparation offering.

familiar.text: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as is the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.

verses.restored: Every male among children of Aaron may eat it, age-long due throughout your generations from fire-offerings of YHWH. Everything that touches them shall become holy.

familiar.text: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the LORD made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.restored: This is offering of Aaron and his sons that they shall bring near to YHWH on day he is anointed: tenth ephah of fine flour as regular grain offering, half in morning and half in evening.

familiar.text: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the LORD in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.

verses.restored: On griddle with oil it shall be made; well mixed you shall bring it; baked pieces of grain offering you shall bring near as soothing scent to YHWH.

familiar.text: In a pan it shall be made with oil; and when it is baken, thou shalt bring it in: and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.restored: The priest anointed in his place from among his sons shall do it; age-long statute to YHWH. Whole offering it shall be turned into smoke.

familiar.text: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: it is a statute for ever unto the LORD; it shall be wholly burnt.

verses.restored: Every grain offering of priest shall be whole offering; it shall not be eaten.

familiar.text: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.restored: Speak to Aaron and his sons, saying: This is instruction/Torah of sin/misalignment offering. In place where burnt offering is slaughtered, sin/misalignment offering shall be slaughtered before YHWH. Holy of Holies it is.

familiar.text: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the LORD: it is most holy.

verses.restored: The priest who offers it for sin/misalignment shall eat it; in holy place it shall be eaten, in court of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.restored: Everything touching its flesh shall become holy; and when any of its blood/life is spattered on garment, what it spattered on you shall wash in holy place.

familiar.text: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.

verses.restored: Earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; if boiled in bronze vessel, it shall be scoured and rinsed with water.

familiar.text: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.

verses.restored: Every male among priests may eat it; Holy of Holies it is.

familiar.text: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.

verses.restored: But any sin/misalignment offering from whose blood/life is brought into tent of meeting to make atonement/covering in holy place shall not be eaten; in fire it shall be burned.

familiar.text: And no sin offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place, shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.

translation_notes: Fraud against neighbor is also unfaithfulness against YHWH; repair requires restitution plus fifth before/with ritual offering.
Ash handling and garments show ordinary cleanup is part of holy service.
Continual altar fire is tended; holiness includes maintenance, not just dramatic ritual.
Priestly portions are provision, but priestly grain offering is wholly offered.
Holy contagion language here is ritual-state language, not moral disgust.
safety_note: Leviticus 6 insists that spiritual repair does not replace material restitution. Stolen, withheld, or fraudulently held goods must be returned with added repair.
